intent: Narrow sensor spread further to ±0.035 m to reduce noise and improve control stability, keep sensor size at 0.016 m for robust detection, and maintain stable geometry. Expect improved line detection consistency and fewer line loss events, especially on the s-bend track. Request integrator to increase ki to 1.2 for enhanced integral correction and reduce base_speed to 1.0 to balance control and progress.
rationale: The integrator feedback confirms that narrowing the sensor spread to ±0.04 m and keeping the sensor size at 0.016 m reduces sensor noise and improves control stability, especially in tight curves like the s-bend. The integrator had to compensate for noise from wider spreads by tuning controller gains and reducing base speed. The current geometry maintains symmetric sensor positions close to the axle for stable sensing. The integrator requests testing a slightly narrower sensor spread at ±0.035 m to further reduce noise and improve stability, increasing the integral gain ki to 1.2 to enhance integral correction if steady-state error persists, and reducing base speed to 1.0 to balance control and progress. I accept these recommendations to refine sensor placement and controller support. I keep other geometry parameters unchanged to preserve stability and sensing robustness. I expect these changes to reduce line loss events and improve completion rates and accuracy on complex tracks, especially the s-bend.
